items.title: Every workout of a programme
items.body: A programme's page now shows all its workouts week by week, built for your gym and days. Tap one to see its exercises, sets and reps.

items.title: Pick your programme length
items.body: Quick, Standard, Extended or Long haul: choose how long a programme runs when you start it, and change it later. Base and Build stretch or shrink to fit.

items.title: Two new programmes
items.body: Athletic engine (6 weeks of jumps, heavy pulls and conditioning) and Fresh start (4 weeks for new or returning members).

items.title: Build your own programme
items.body: Explore → Programmes → New programme: pick a goal, length and your own workouts in 4 steps. Or tap Make it mine on any programme to copy and change it.
